versions.subject: Add files via upload
versions.detection:
description: Add more office applications to the rule logic of choice
selection1:
  EventLog: EDR
  EventType: WMIExecution
  WMIcommand: '*Win32_Process\:\:Create*'
selection2:
  - Image:
    - '*\winword.exe'
    - '*\excel.exe'
    - '*\powerpnt.exe'
condition: selection1 AND selection2
